headline: Sensex and Nifty open higher driven by foreign fund inflows and easing crude oil prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows (FPIs/FIIs) returned to support overall market sentiment.
Easing crude oil prices helped lower input cost concerns for Indian markets.
Investors are closely watching the US midterm election developments and global market cues.
Stock-specific actions continue ahead of key quarterly earnings announcements and Diwali.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty opened higher in early trade supported by positive institutional flows.
Titan Company is in focus with Q2 profit expected to rise up to 27% YoY.
Shares of SBI and ITC recorded gains in early trade amid cautious market sentiment.
BLS Polymers shares rallied 6% following a strong debut on the stock market.
summary: Indian markets opened on a positive note supported by foreign fund inflows and softer crude oil prices. Stock-specific action was visible in Titan ahead of its Q2 results, while SBI and ITC posted gains. Investors remain focused on US midterm election outcomes and upcoming corporate earnings.
